card.name: Verb after a 'past years' time span
card.fires_on: The verb (grew, has, have) or comma right after a subject that follows a phrase like 'over the last 10 years' or 'since 2007'. It marks where a trend over a period is about to be described.

modes.label: Auxiliary after span
modes.description: 'has' or 'have' following the subject once a past-period phrase has been given.
modes.example: In the past century the Church<< has>> grown both extensively and intensively among English

modes.label: Growth verb
modes.description: A verb like 'grew' that begins a statement about change over the stated years.
modes.example: From 1983 to 2008, total U.S. GDP<< grew>> from $6.1 trillion to $

modes.label: Comma after span
modes.description: The comma closing an introductory time-span phrase.
modes.example: In the last 10 years<<,>> advances in broadband technologies have dramatically altered the

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese phrases meaning 'in recent years' and 'over the years', and promotes words like 'consistently' and 'constant', so it favors continuing-trend wording.
card.plain: It fires at the verb that starts describing how something changed over a stretch of recent years.
